title: "Sharing Jesus" Evangelism Conference
time: 7:00 PM-8:30 PM Friday; 9:00 AM-3:30 PM Saturday
location: Grace Anglican Church, Fleming Island, FL
description: Join us for an evangelism conference designed to equip and encourage believers to share the gospel with confidence and clarity. Rooted in the Great Commission, this five-session experience will explore the importance of evangelism, relational witness, practical ways to share the gospel, engaging questions through apologetics, and telling your personal story of faith.
